productName: French Country 3 Drawer Dresser with Door
description:
The French Country 3 Drawer Dresser with Door has three drawers and a cabinet with a door and two adjustable shelves. It measures 54 inches wide, 33 inches high, and 22 inches deep.

The drawers are 5/8-inch dovetail drawers on full-extension slides, and the top has round-over edges. Use the drawers for clothing, diapers, and accessories, and the cabinet for blankets, towels, and larger items. It is made of solid wood with French Country detailing.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
